adjudication_records.issue_text: | P2 | src/sentry/monitors/logic/incident_occurrence.py:168 | The copied and display-normalized `config` is never returned, leaving dead transformation code that will mislead future maintainers about the monitor context contract. | maintainability | 0.99 |

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff for `get_monitor_environment_context` in `incident_occurrence.py` lines 158-171, the function creates a `config` variable by copying `monitor_environment.monitor.config`, then conditionally modifies `config['schedule_type']`, but the returned dictionary uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` directly instead of the modified `config` variable. This means the schedule_type transformation is never actually applied to the returned context. This is dead code that represents a real bug - the intended transformation is not being applied.
